# NRC Event Notification Report fixtures — RECONSTRUCTED, NOT CAPTURED

These HTML files were written by hand from the published layout of the NRC
Event Notification Report pages
(`https://www.nrc.gov/documents-reports/document-collections/events-reports-associated-with/event-notification-reports/YYYY/YYYYMMDDen`).
nrc.gov was not reachable from the environment they were written in, so they
are not byte-for-byte copies of real pages. Event numbers, facilities and
narratives are illustrative; do not cite them.

Replace them with captured pages (and keep the tests green) once a live page
has been fetched.
